metas.name: 1 · ★ 7.0 · 1969 · Olsenbanden - Operasjon Egon
metas.description: Egon Olsen has been behind bars for some time, but that hasn't stopped the criminal mastermind from making a plan to steal a very valuable golden statue and to never land behind bars again. So as soon as he gets out of prison, the...

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.5 · 1970 · Olsen-banden og Dynamitt-Harry
metas.description: After jail, the Olsen gang meets up again, but there's love in the air for Egon. he decides that ordinary steady work is the future. But honest work doesn't help if you are wrongfully accused. But Dynemite Harry is their secret we...

metas.name: 3 · ★ 6.8 · 1972 · Olsen-banden tar gull
metas.description: Egon returns from prison with the key to a big heist, a hidden Nazi-treasure. After some trouble, the Olsen Gang finds the place, but problems are still topped when the international criminals Carina and Ricco turns up.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 6.6 · 1973 · Olsen-banden og Dynamitt-Harry går amok
metas.description: Egon Olsen and his gang is about to commit their biggest heist - stealing 6 millions from an under cover operation at a freight company, which the police also follows closely. The safe is both guarded by alarm and the company gori...

metas.name: 5 · ★ 6.5 · 1974 · Olsen-banden møter kongen og knekten
metas.description: The Olsen Gang becomes millionaires. Unfortunately for the gang, their arch-enemies, the King and the Jack, are planning to steal the money for themselves.

metas.name: 6 · ★ 6.4 · 1975 · Olsenbandens siste bedrifter
metas.description: The Olsen Gang has to pay for their summer vacation in Spain, and Egon is hired to open a safe with black market money in Switzerland. He is conned, but Egon has sworn revenge.

metas.name: 7 · ★ 6.9 · 1976 · Olsenbanden for full musikk
metas.description: Valborg needs to get her son Basse married, after getting a girl pregnant, while Egon has got work for a baron. However a spook makes trouble for his planned coup against the National Theater.

metas.name: 8 · ★ 6.5 · 1977 · Olsenbanden og Dynamitt-Harry på sporet
metas.description: The Olsen Gang is robbed in Spain and loses the millions they earned from their last heist. Egon has a plan to get the money back by robbing the National State Railways for a gold transport.

metas.name: 9 · ★ 6.5 · 1978 · Olsenbanden og Data-Harry sprenger verdensbanken
metas.description: With the help of a corrupt diplomat the Olsen Gang plans to rob the World Bank, with the re-schooled dynamite Harry, now a computer expert.

metas.name: 10 · ★ 6.4 · 1979 · Olsenbanden og Dynamitt-Harry mot nye høyder
metas.description: An unfaithful servant in the Norwegian Petroleum Directorate tries to sell top secret information to German industry leaders. Egon has a plan to earn money on the transaction himself.

metas.name: 11 · ★ 6.3 · 1981 · Olsenbanden gir seg aldri!
metas.description: Kontanter er snart avlegs med det inflasjonstempoet vi har. Bedre med verdipapirer og fast eiendom. Disse tankene har Olsenbanden gjort seg, og de tenker stort: Ved å skaffe tilveie et skjult regnskap i Team Finans har de sjansen ...

metas.name: 12 · ★ 6.4 · 1982 · Olsenbandens aller siste kupp
metas.description: The Olsen Gang is involved in a weapon trade for half a billion. It's their final coup, and Valborg is finally allowed to participate.

metas.name: 13 · ★ 6.2 · 1984 · 'Men Olsenbanden var ikke død!'
metas.description: The Olsen Gang has traveled south after having success with their last coup. But someone still hasn't given up catching them.

metas.name: 14 · ★ 5.3 · 1999 · Olsenbandens siste stikk
metas.description: Fifteen years after they last saw each other Benny, Valborg and Dynamitt-Harry discovers that Egon Olsen is out of prison and living in a retirement home. Olsenbanden is reunited, and Egon has a plan. He knows about an old Frans J...

metas.name: 15 · ★ 5.2 · 2022 · Olsenbanden - Siste skrik!
metas.description: The Olsen gang of Egon, Benny and Kjell are constantly looking for the big coup to become millionaires. They have laid out the perfect plan to break into the new Munch Museum in Bjørvika and steal "Scream".
